title: Resurrection of Christ
definition: The resurrection of Christ is God’s raising of Jesus bodily from the dead, declaring His victory over sin, death, and judgment, and confirming the certainty of salvation and future resurrection.
summary: The resurrection is essential to the Gospel. Christ did not merely survive in memory or spirit; He rose bodily, appeared to witnesses, and lives forever.
christFocus: Because Christ is risen, the believer’s faith is not empty. The risen Lord gives life, hope, justification, and the promise that death will not have the final word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The resurrection confirms Christ’s identity and saving work.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: It is bodily, historical, and victorious.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: It guarantees the believer’s future resurrection and present newness of life.
